meta.description: Shows which room each phone, tablet or watch is in, using Bluetooth proxies placed around the home.

m5stack-atom-lite.description: A thumb-sized ESP32 board with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, a button and an LED, powered over USB.
m5stack-atom-lite.does: Runs ESPHome as a Bluetooth proxy: it listens for phones, tablets and watches and forwards what it hears to Home Assistant, so the home knows which room a device is in. The same board also runs ESPSomfy-RTS firmware (not ESPHome) as the radio bridge of the awnings, carrying a radio module.

hlk-ld2410c.description: A 24 GHz millimetre-wave radar module that senses people, moving or still, and measures their distance.
hlk-ld2410c.does: Wired to a proxy board, it reports presence and detection distance to Home Assistant. The Ramka uses it to wake the screen when someone comes into the room.
